svg.title: Spring PetClinic Microservices — Full Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing user browser, Azure cloud infrastructure with AKS cluster containing 7 microservices, CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions, and monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and Zipkin.

g.text: customers · vets · visits — persistent storage · port 3306
